cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.
